description: The shared enforcement layer: one implementation of the write guard, the read-and-command secret guard, the formatter, the Definition-of-Done Stop gate and the second-brain distiller. Every stack fact each one needs comes from the consuming repository's harness.config.json, so this file names no toolchain and no directory. Addressed through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, which resolves identically in a main checkout, a git worktree and a sandbox — the property a repo-relative path does not have.

PreToolUse.note: One matcher over the whole surface. The write guard needs every tool that can put bytes on disk, including NotebookEdit and any MCP write; the secret guard needs Read and Bash. These were two matchers in two scripts because both shelled out to an interpreter and firing them on every search was a real cost. This hook shells out to nothing, so the cost is gone and the split with it.
